_comment: mcp-content.json — content_agent profile. Pulls research from FAISS, CRM context from SQLite/LMCP, writes output via Filesystem; Safari MCP for visual preview screenshots.

filesystem._comment: Read/write slides, reports, PPTX scripts. Output goes to <repo>/runtime/workspace/<project>/. MIT.

faiss._comment: Pull research findings for slide content. Uses vllm-mlx embedding model. MIT.

sqlite._comment: CRM context — relevant contacts, companies, deal context pulled via SELECT queries. MIT.

lmcp._comment: LMCP for pulling CRM data from Apple Contacts (supplemental to SQLite) and for reading OneDrive/Notes for additional context. Proprietary, currently free.

safari_mcp._comment: Safari MCP for visual preview of slides (file:// URLs) and browsing reference material. MIT.
